t2.thesis: NOW goes into the print after an ~18% one-month run-up, trading at roughly the Street target, and it has fallen at the exit-A open after each of its last four prints despite beats, so expectations look high enough to pull the odds slightly below the base rate.
reasons: Last 4 prints all lost at exit-A (0/4), including -14% and -10% on in-line or small beats, a pattern of high bars on guidance and cRPO
1-month return of +18% and 5-day return of +3.7% into the print raise the bar (sell-the-news risk); spot ~155 is already near the ~157 Street target
Implied move ~10%, so the outcome is mostly a coin flip on the guide; the base-rate drift is small next to that
Partial offsets: software rotation tailwind, raised FY outlook last quarter, AI ACV >$1B, and call IV above put IV with a negative put-skew factor
Put/call volume of 2.5 shows hedging demand; it is ambiguous but slightly supports a crowded positioning read
t2.deciding_variable: cRPO growth versus the ~21% trend, plus Q4 subscription guidance and cRPO guidance, especially any federal deal-timing or deceleration commentary

prior.from: I3 base rates: software_internet cluster t0_hit 0.541 (n=919), consistent with AMC session 0.538 and overall ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report (October 28, 2026) is tomorrow relative to today's date and falls after my knowledge cutoff, so I can't say how ServiceNow's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down ~6 points from 0.54: about -4 for the recent run-up and the stock sitting at the target price, and about -3 for the persistent negative post-print reaction history. Options skew and the sector rotation tailwind add back about +1.

theses.mechanism: The run-up priced in a beat; an in-line cRPO guide or a slight deceleration triggers profit-taking, as in Jan and Apr 2026
theses.wrong_if: cRPO growth accelerates to 22%+ cc and the Q4 guide is clearly above consensus

theses.mechanism: Strong Q3 federal seasonality and AI ACV upside drive a beat-and-raise that confirms the enterprise software re-rating narrative
theses.wrong_if: Margins compress from Armis/Veza integration costs, or the FCF guide is cut

theses.mechanism: A clean beat roughly in line with whisper numbers leaves a muted reaction, like the July and Oct 2025 prints (~-0.8%), so the result is near zero with a slight negative lean
theses.wrong_if: Guidance surprises materially in either direction

key_observations: Q4 subscription revenue and cRPO guidance versus consensus
Net new ACV from AI products and the Now Assist/Otto pro-plus attach rate
Armis/Veza contribution and its impact on operating margin and FCF
Federal deal timing and any macro or seat-based pricing commentary
Count of $1M+ transactions and growth in $5M+ customers
